starting_state: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. No masks are set (every mask reads X), the sequencer is stopped and the Channel screen is showing.

steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 plays pattern 1 on steps 1-4 with the notes C, D, E and F at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, and no masks are set. Turn E1 to open Channel tasks, scroll to Masks and press K3, then turn E2 to Vel. The value reads X: there is no channel velocity mask, so every step plays the velocity it has in pattern 1. X means inherit.

With no step held, turn E3 right until the screen reads 50. This channel velocity mask replaces the pattern's velocities: every note now plays at 50, so the whole phrase is softer. Pitch and timing are unchanged.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4) and turn E3 right until the screen reads 90. While a step is held, the screen shows that step's own velocity.
Release step 1. A step mask overrides the channel mask, so step 1 plays at 90 as an accent while steps 2 to 4 keep the channel velocity of 50. The screen goes back to the channel value, 50.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4) and keep holding it. Turn E3 left until the screen reads 0. Velocity 0 is a silent step, which is different from X: X means inherit and still plays. Step 2 is now muted, so a pass plays steps 1, 3 and 4 only. Step 2 is still held in this frame.
Release step 2. The screen returns to 50, but step 2 stays silent: read the MIDI strip, where the loop plays C3 (60) at 90, then E3 (64) and F3 (65) at 50, and step 2's D is missing.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 2 again, press K2 to clear its masks and release it. The step mask is gone, so step 2 plays at the channel velocity of 50 again and step 1 keeps its accent at 90: velocities 90, 50, 50, 50.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E2 to Len and turn E3 right until the screen reads 1/2. All four notes now have a half-step gate. The velocities stay at 90, 50, 50 and 50.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop
